extracted.summary: A solicitor at Oakes Law enquires about around £34,000 of funding for his client's costs to final hearing in financial remedy proceedings at the Family Court at Birmingham, where matrimonial assets are about £477,500.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and passed to our underwriting team. To take this further we would need your client's full name and address, confirmation of the stage and any listed hearing dates, and a costs estimate or schedule broken down by stage. We would also need details of the assets in dispute, including title and valuation evidence for the family home and investments, and confirmation of any existing charges or competing claims. Please also confirm your firm's details and that you are instructed. We will come back to you once we have reviewed the information provided.
